16f656d4eb064fb32b9dbc6c74688cd0.content: {"groups":[{"group":50,"clusters":[{"name":"The little door to the garden","kind":"place","note":"The small fifteen-inch door in the hall that leads to a passage and the garden, locked with a little golden key on a glass table; both entries describe this same door, so they belong together.","members":["down-the-rabbit-hole:location:little_door_garden","the-pool-of-tears:location:garden_door"]}]}]}

56cd492148c00fc0c3453e69230b434d.content: {"groups":[{"group":51,"clusters":[{"name":"Long Hall","kind":"place","note":"The long hall of the house with the small garden door and the glass table, where Alice grows and shrinks; the same hall is reached again through a tree-door, so both entries are one place.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:long_hall","a-mad-tea-party:location:long_hall"]}]}]}

f418f67c3d083c2929eca354288b99d8.content: {"groups":[{"group":52,"clusters":[{"name":"The little door in the hall","kind":"place","note":"The small locked door in the hall (the little golden key door) that leads toward the garden; distinct from the garden itself, which lies beyond it.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:garden_door"]},{"name":"The garden","kind":"place","note":"The beautiful garden of flower-beds and fountains reached through the tree-door, including its entrance by the rose-tree where the card gardeners paint the roses; the entrance is part of this same garden, not a separate place.","members":["a-mad-tea-party:location:garden","the-queens-croquet-ground:location:rose_tree_garden"]}]}]}

db1cd4f7a45fd824cf9560ffb50a4283.content: {"groups":[{"group":53,"clusters":[{"name":"Pool of Tears","kind":"place","note":"The body of water formed from Alice's tears, where Alice swims with the Mouse and the birds and animals swim; distinct from the shore, which is the bank.","members":["the-pool-of-tears:location:pool_of_tears"]},{"name":"Bank of the Pool of Tears","kind":"place","note":"The dry shore beside the pool where the wet party dries off, holds the Caucus-Race, and where Alice is left alone at the end; distinct from the water itself.","members":["a-caucus-race-and-a-long-tale:location:bank_of_the_pool"]}]}]}

8c27212a2ba2cc6bc71d40927aad745e.content: {"groups":[{"group":54,"clusters":[{"name":"The thick wood (Alice's first wood)","kind":"place","note":"The wood where Alice wanders after escaping the crowd, meets the puppy and finds the mushroom; distinct from the mushroom clearing within it and from the Duchess's woods.","members":["the-rabbit-sends-in-a-little-bill:location:wood"]},{"name":"The mushroom clearing","kind":"place","note":"The open clearing where the Caterpillar sits on a large round mushroom and where Alice nibbles it; a specific spot, not the wood at large.","members":["advice-from-a-caterpillar:location:mushroom_clearing"]},{"name":"The woods around the Duchess's house","kind":"place","note":"The woods by the Duchess's house where the footmen run out, the pig escapes and the Cheshire Cat sits in a tree; tied to the Duchess's residence.","members":["pig-and-pepper:location:wood"]},{"name":"The wood after the tea-party","kind":"place","note":"The wood Alice picks her way through after leaving the March Hare's tea-party and before the tree-door to the garden; tied to the tea-party, not the Duchess's house.","members":["a-mad-tea-party:location:wood"]}]}]}

e595b67f59d7d130fbee1b47ef34e30b.content: {"groups":[{"group":55,"clusters":[{"name":"the Queen's croquet-ground","kind":"place","note":"The single walled-garden croquet ground of the Queen, with flamingo mallets and hedgehog balls, where the game and executions take place; both entries describe this same place.","members":["the-queens-croquet-ground:location:croquet_ground","the-mock-turtles-story:location:croquet_ground"]}]}]}

68e458fda58198d05826cd255250ff31.content: {"groups":[{"group":56,"clusters":[{"name":"Court of Justice","kind":"place","note":"The open court of the Queen of Hearts, with throne, jury-box and table of tarts, where the trial is held; the Lobster Quadrille entry is the same court heard in the distance before it is shown on stage.","members":["the-lobster-quadrille:location:court_of_justice","who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court"]}]}]}

962e40a5d6919e0606aca41d710e3d19.content: {"groups":[{"group":57,"clusters":[{"name":"The Queen of Hearts's court of justice","kind":"place","note":"The open courtroom of the Queen of Hearts, with throne, jury-box and table of tarts, where the Knave's trial takes place; the Lobster Quadrille entry is the same court heard in the distance as the trial begins, so all three entries are one place.","members":["the-lobster-quadrille:location:court_of_justice","who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court","alices-evidence:location:the_court"]}]}]}

419b1e84c4d885c19650083c228b50d0.content: {"groups":[{"group":58,"clusters":[{"name":"The court of the Queen of Hearts","kind":"place","note":"The single open courtroom of the Queen of Hearts, with throne, jury-box and table of tarts, where the trial of the Knave takes place; both entries describe this same court across divisions.","members":["who-stole-the-tarts:location:the_court","alices-evidence:location:the_court"]}]}]}
